checks.name: layer2_real_mcp_tool_returns
checks.observed: Real MCP initialize (dcc-mcp-zbrush 0.2.32, protocol 2025-06-18), tools/list (32 tools, nextCursor 3332) and 7 real tools/call over /mcp. 3 succeeded: list_skills, load_skill, and zbrush_dialog__get_active_dialog (success=true, bridge_state=ready, zbrush_blocked=false).

checks.name: documented_main_affinity_limitation
checks.observed: 4 real tools/call returned isError=true with THREAD_AFFINITY_UNAVAILABLE. In sidecar mode attach_dispatcher is a no-op and host_dispatcher_attached=False, so main-affinity tools cannot be deferred. Recorded as a genuine product limitation with its root cause, not suppressed or fixed out of scope.
